message: The other day, while I was organizing our emergency supplies for the upcoming storm, my kids thought it was time for a snack break. I ended up with a bag of chips in one hand and a flashlight in the other, trying to explain why we need to be ready without sounding like a total buzzkill. Kids might not get the seriousness of it all, but at least they can appreciate the snacks. Sometimes, being prepared is just about finding the right balance between urgency and a snack-filled distraction.
